about: What of the xrpl-lab live-testnet runs (the Robot rig's xrpl-lab-runs folder: the 2.6.0 AMM live-fire runs, the 2.6.1 helper-wallet sweeps and the 2.6.1 release sweep, 2026-10-20/21) may be public in rnd-data. Deny by default for content: a file is public only when a public rule names it, it carries no content marker, and the identity scan passed it. Rules are checked in order: identity (from the reasons file), then private, then content markers, then public; anything left is private as 'unapproved'. Written by the Book Keeper on R&D's brief and reviewed by R&D (2026-10-21); the Publisher's merge of this file is their agreement, as with receipts.json, and either side changes it only by agreement. The curated, redacted receipts are already public in xrpl-lab under docs/receipts/. Patterns: 'name' matches the file name, 'path' the path under xrpl-lab-runs/ (fnmatch; * crosses folders). Licences, first match wins, for public files only: the harness scripts are MIT; everything else, including the XRPL Testnet ledger records, is CC BY 4.0 (rnd-data's data licence).

private.name: wallet*.json
private.why: secrets: a wallet file holds a seed. None was ever written into a run folder (wallets stayed in the scratch home); this rule keeps one out if it ever is. rnd's reasons have no 'secrets', so it is 'unapproved'

private.name: *seed*
private.why: secrets: anything named for a seed. None exists; the rule is a floor
the logged Argon consult: not needed for the runs' provenance, and publishing it is a separate call

public.name: command.txt
public.why: the command, the code sha, the redacted env lines and the exit code from PIPESTATUS

public.name: preflight.txt
public.why: the testnet-only preflight: env unset, classify_network, network guard

public.name: stdout.txt
public.why: the module's own output, unredacted (a file carrying a home path is private for identity first)

public.name: state.json
public.why: xrpl-lab's state: wallet address, completed modules, tx index (public testnet data; a file carrying a home path is private for identity first)
the read-only ledger capture after each run: tx lookups, account_info, account_tx, server_state, amm_info, simulate; public XRPL Testnet records

public.name: env.txt
public.why: the AMM runs' env record: placeholders for the scratch home, unset RPC/faucet vars, Python/xrpl-py/xrpl-lab versions

public.name: capture.log
public.why: the sweeps' capture summary: hash lookups and account balances, public testnet data
the sweep scripts and their README
